what: terminal colours for the asteroid executable: plain 16-colour ANSI SGR codes, downstream of the logo (4ST teal -> cyan, eroid blue -> blue). Raw on purpose; no 256-colour or true-colour codes.
rules: print ESC[<code>m before the text and ESC[0m after it; print no codes at all when the NO_COLOR variable is set or stdout is not a terminal.
banner: 4ST in logo (cyan) then eroid in logo_alt (blue), on one line: ESC[36m4ST ESC[34meroid ESC[0m (no spaces)
